proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ _ s x hx
  rw [convexHull_eq_union] at hx
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, hts, hai, hxt⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨t, hts, ?_, hxt⟩
  have h1 := hai.card_le_finrank_succ
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (Set.range ((↑) : t → E))) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E :=
    Submodule.finrank_le _
  simp only [Fintype.card_coe] at h1
  omega
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (s : Set E) (x : E), x ∈ convexHull ℝ s → ∃ t : Finset E, (t : Set E) ⊆ s ∧ t.card ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E + 1 ∧ x ∈ convexHull ℝ (t : Set E)
